newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil drug dealers use Santa to boost sales.
newsitem.headline: Brazil drug dealers use Santa to boost sales.

text.p: Brazilian police confiscated 35 Santa Claus dolls with bags full of marijuana in a Rio de Janeiro shantytown, a newspaper said on Tuesday.
The dolls, with .5 or .8 ounce (14- or 24-grams) of the drug in their toy bags, were to be given as special Christmas gifts to the drug traffickers' best clients, O Globo said.

Police found them in the Lagartixa shantytown during a routine raid in which another 23 pounds (10.5 kg) of marijuana was also found, O Globo said. More than 14,100 pounds (6,400 kg) of marijuana has been seized so far this year in the state of Rio de Janeiro.
